pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular sub-polygonal dark regions with diffuse edge gradients and low-frequency angularity. Patch area is relatively consistent across the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes near the ventral and caudal regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Network of light-tan negative space showing frequent tri-radiate and quadri-radiate junction nodes. The pathways maintain a thin, relatively uniform pixel width and demonstrate high topological continuity across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the dorsal-cervical line, characterized by brownish-orange pixel clusters projecting from the upper neck profile against the background foliage.
